name: ended-that-is-not-a-boolean-is-refused-400
description: An "ended" that is not a JSON boolean is refused with HTTP 400, here the string "true" beside a well-formed agent_id. Neither backend reads a truthy value as an end: a stop that forgets an identity's records has to say so exactly (#525). The attempt holds EXCLUSIVE on notes.md first, so a backend that ignored the bad field would answer 200 listing it. Both backends answer in the same words.
